scope: CPU-only bounded raw-preprocessing audit; no model forward, training interruption, production code edits or original-data writes.
matlab: 26.2.0.3433840 (R2026b) Update 1, Ada, -singleCompThread, Image Processing Toolbox license available
pipeline: Raw uint8 RGB -> im2double; use official DRIVE/HRF FOV as logical, bypass automatic threshold FOV detection.

souradnice: MATLAB edge(final_closed) default edge detector; row/column midpoint modes rounded give center. Radius=round(mode(Euclidean distances from center to edge pixels))+1. Diameter=2*radius. This is not bbox extent.
image_adjustment: imresize(double RGB, pixels_per_degree*degrees/diameter) default bicubic; preserve entire frame. imresize masks to exact output HW with nearest.
local_contrast_and_clahe: erode FOV with strel disk1; bwdist; Sobel imgradientxy; extrapolate interp2 linear with zero outside using coordinate minus gradient/4*distance.
imgaussfilt with replicate padding and sigma=80/(55/25), regardless of image resampling resolution. Compute (extrapolated-background)/background+0.5; clamp0..1.
rgb2hsv; adapthisteq on V with NumTiles=round(HW/(250/(55/25))) and ClipLimit=.005; hsv2rgb; zero outside FOV.
Historical commented DICOM export: uint16(round(normalized*4096)); later active nnUNet export:uint8(round(normalized*255)).

calibration.training_path_evidence: Ves_Class/Main_Training.py dataset=data_preprocessed_dicom_25N; Main_Predict.py uses data_preprocessed_dicom_25N_UBMI. This supports an intended25px profile, but is not proof of provenance of each historical training file.
calibration.later_export: MAIN_VA.m resolution35, Task535_Ophtalmo, active nnUNet uint8 export; local contrast remains hard-coded25.

limitations: Source-executed R2026b outputs are deterministic test references, not a certification against unknown2022/2023 MATLAB/toolbox runtime or original prepared training DICOM.
Only official provided FOV paths exercised; automatic souradnice threshold paths and UBMI-specific morphology remain untested.
Zero dummy vessel was supplied for the proxy photometry comparison; actual AV supervision/removal of unknown labels is not tested.
No proprietary MathWorks toolbox source read or copied.
